TC-17/S21.title: Copy A&P on live generated notes, every built-in template
TC-17/S21.detail: pr-tc17-dev.spec.ts D2 on dev 8b4be94a (live Haiku 4.5), one dictation per context, each built-in template generated in the app: soap, hp, consult, snf-progress, snf-admission, snf-consult -> Copy A&P enabled, clipboard starts at the Assessment heading ('Assessment', 'Assessment and Plan', 'Assessment of Active Medical Problems'), runs to the end of Plan / Recommendations / Care Plan, is a verbatim part of the shown note, holds the plan and nothing from Subjective/HPI/exam (6/6). discharge and snf-discharge -> no Copy A&P (2/2). The model tagged every A&P section correctly in all 8 notes. Cleanup: 0 rows left, no foreign change.
